title: Steering Emergent Behavior in Multi-Agent LLM Systems via Information Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.11714v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in groups, each pursuing an individual objective while jointly determining system performance. If an operator controls which agent observes which other agent, but not their payoffs or messages, how should observations be structured to raise collective welfare? We make the information network (who observes whom) a design object, decoupled from the fixed interaction network over which agents act. Ten identical LLM agents play repeated group-decision games; by default each observes only an anonymous summary of the group's previous-round outcome, and a manager with a fixed budget adds directed observation links that reveal peers' past actions. Across 1,080 episodes and six games spanning coordination, anti-coordination, social dilemmas, and discovery, we ask how much information to share and, at a fixed budget, who should observe whom. translated_title: 通过信息网络引导多智能体大语言模型系统中的涌现行为
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.11714v2 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地以群体方式运作，每个智能体追求各自的目标，同时共同决定系统的整体表现。如果操作者只能控制哪个智能体观察哪个其他智能体，而无法控制其收益或消息内容，那么应如何构建观察结构以提升集体福利？我们将信息网络（谁观察谁）作为一个设计对象，并将其与智能体行动所依托的固定交互网络解耦。十个相同的LLM智能体进行重复的群体决策博弈；默认情况下，每个智能体只能观察群体上一轮结果的匿名汇总，而一个拥有固定预算的管理者可以添加有向观察链接，以揭示其他智能体的过去行为。在涵盖协调博弈、反协调博弈、社会困境和发现类任务的六种博弈、共1,080个回合的实验中，我们研究了应共享多少信息，以及在固定预算下谁应该观察谁。信息披露产生了行为耦合：（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文的核心创新是将“信息网络”（谁观察谁）作为独立于交互网络的可设计对象，证明管理者在固定预算下通过有策略地添加智能体间的观察链接，即可引导多智能体LLM系统中的涌现行为并提升集体福利。
en_tdlr: This paper's key contribution is treating the information network (who observes whom) as a designable object decoupled from the interaction network, showing that a manager can steer emergent behavior and improve collective welfare in multi-agent LLM systems by strategically adding observation links under a fixed budget.
